newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Colombia Ecopetrol to issue $850 mln petro-bonds.
newsitem.headline: Colombia Ecopetrol to issue $850 mln petro-bonds.

text.p: Colombia's state-run oil company Ecopetrol announced it would issue $840 million in bonds in domestic and foreign markets to finance "priority projects".

The company will issue $300 million in fixed term, fixed interest bonds in Colombia, together with another $240 million in bonds whose interest rates will be linked to production levels in fields operated solely by Ecopetrol.
The remaining $300 million will be issued to international markets and will be tied to production at the Cusiana field in Colombia's eastern plains, an Ecopetrol statement said.
Cusiana is operated by British Petroleum Co Plc in association with two other private sector partners and Ecopetrol.
Ecopetrol said it was still studying the period of the bonds and how they would be issued to the markets. It did not say which "priority" projects it was looking to finance with the capital raised.
